title: Hearty Indulgent Ukrainian Cheese Bake
description: A rich and creamy Ukrainian dish featuring a blend of cheeses and a touch of sweetness, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven. This keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the softened cream cheese and crumbly farmers cheese.
Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Stir in the caster sugar, vanilla extract, lemon zest, chopped fresh dill, and salt.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
